name: label
title: Label
description: Solid label component for form controls and field shells.

meta.customization: Style labels through ui-label and compose them into field shells when helper text or errors are needed.

parity.baseUi: Thin UI label aligns with Base UI Field Label semantics by rendering a native label and styling hook. Gaps: automatic control registration, generated for/id wiring, required marker policy, and disabled propagation remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Comparable to Kobalte form-control label composition when used inside Field. Gaps: context-driven ID registration and richer field state data are not owned by this standalone wrapper.
